name: access
description: Manage custom permits and private dashboard access for users or roles.
usage: access list [dashboard] | access fix | access add <target> <command|module|dashboard|all> | access remove <target> <command|module|dashboard|all>

name: add-income-role
description: Add a new income-providing role

name: add-money
description: Add money to a user

name: add-money-role
description: Add money to all users with a role

name: afk
description: Set your AFK status, view active server AFK members, or reset AFK records (Admin/Owner).

name: au
description: Allow users into your PVC

name: balance
description: Shows your balance or a specified user's balance

name: buy-item
description: Buy an item from the store

name: clean-leaderboard
description: Remove members who left from the leaderboard

name: coinflip
description: Flip a coin with a 2x multiplier payout.

name: collect
description: Collect your role-based passive income

name: confession
description: Manage Confession module channel, log channel, submission panel, repair/repost clean confessions, or perform a reset.

name: create
description: Buy or extend PVC time

name: create-item
description: Create a new item in the store

name: daily
description: Claim your daily currency reward and grow your streak multiplier

name: delete-item
description: Delete an item from the store

name: deposit
description: Deposit cash into your bank

name: dragme
description: Request a user to drag you into their voice channel.

name: edit-item
description: Edit a store item's properties (price, name, stock, usable, sellable, description)

name: fmv
description: Force Move a target user to your voice channel when they are in or join voice.

name: game
description: Manage single-destination game ping configurations and test channel.

name: give-item
description: Give an item to another user

name: give-money
description: Give cash to another user

name: help
description: Display interactive bot help menu, category details, or specific command information.

name: hide
description: Hide or unhide a channel by managing ViewChannel permissions for @everyone, all roles, or a specific role.

name: i
description: Show info and control panel for your PVC

name: ignore
description: Configure command or module whitelist/blacklist execution rules per role, channel, or user.

name: info
description: Display comprehensive bot specs, system stats, and community telemetry.

name: invc
description: List all members in a voice channel.

name: inventory
description: Shows your inventory or a specified user's inventory

name: item-info
description: Shows detailed information about a store item

name: item-options
description: Shows all configurable item options, behaviors, and triggers

name: leaderboard
description: View the server economy leaderboard

name: list
description: List members in a role, human server administrators, or bot accounts.

name: list-roles
description: List all roles that provide passive income

name: lock
description: Lock or unlock a channel by managing SendMessages permissions for @everyone, all roles, or a specific role.

name: maintenance
description: View or toggle global maintenance mode (Bot Owner only).

name: media
description: Manage media channel filtering and auto-threading configuration.

name: mines
description: Play Mines on a 3x3 grid with customizable mine count and dynamic multipliers.

name: money-audit-log
description: View recent money audit logs

name: move
description: Move a user or multiple users to a voice channel or to another user's voice channel.

name: mv
description: Move multiple users to your current voice channel.

name: noprefix
description: Toggle or set no-prefix command execution mode for a user, or list users with no-prefix mode enabled.

name: nuke
description: Nuke current channel by cloning it (retaining permissions and position) and deleting the original.

name: ping
description: Display real-time WebSocket, database, and roundtrip ping telemetry.

name: purge
description: Purge recent messages matching an optional user/filter, or purge a role from all members.

name: pvc
description: Manage the PVC system

name: remove-income-role
description: Remove an income-providing role

name: remove-money
description: Remove money from a user

name: remove-money-role
description: Remove money from all users with a role

name: reset-economy
description: Reset the entire server economy

name: reset-money
description: Reset your own balance, or a mentioned user's balance (requires Admin)

name: restart
description: Gracefully restart the bot instance (Bot Owner only).

name: restrict
description: Revoke custom command/module permit from a user or role.

name: rmv
description: Request a user to be moved into your voice channel (requires their consent).

name: role
description: Manage roles: add, remove, or toggle role(s) on a user, batch-manage a role across users/role members, or set role icons.

name: rp
description: Announce a game session by pinging its configured role and linking its destination VC.

name: rpc
description: Manage bot dynamic presence (RPC), status, activity, and rotation modes.

name: sell-item
description: Sell an item from your inventory back for cash with confirmation.

name: set-bank-capacity
description: Set or remove bank capacity for a user or default server capacity

name: set-currency
description: Set the currency symbol

name: set-game-cooldown
description: Set the cooldown in seconds for minigames (coinflip, mines) or economy jobs (work, slut, crime, rob)

name: set-income-reset
description: Set passive income reset duration

name: set-passive-chat-income
description: Toggle passive chat income and set amount

name: set-start-balance
description: Set the starting balance for new users

name: setlogs
description: Set or disable the server audit log channel for moderation and bot actions.

name: shiftvc
description: Move all members from one voice channel to another with live tracking.

name: slowmode
description: Set Discord native slowmode on current text channel.

name: snipe
description: Retrieve recently deleted or edited messages in this channel, or clear snipe history.

name: stats
description: View server economy statistics

name: steal
description: Steal custom emojis, stickers, images, or links and add them to server emojis.

name: sticky
description: Create, edit, remove, refresh, or list sticky messages in channels.
usage: sticky <message...> | sticky edit <new_message...> | sticky remove | sticky refresh | sticky list

name: store
description: Shows all items and roles available in the server store

name: suggestion
description: Manage Suggestion channel, panel, blacklist, status (accept/deny/consider), or reset.

name: take-item
description: Take an item from a user's inventory (Staff only)

name: update-income
description: Force a mass payout for all members with a specific role

name: update-income-role
description: Update an existing income-providing role

name: use-item
description: Use an item from your inventory to trigger its effects or roles.

name: vc
description: Complete voice channel management: mute, unmute, deafen, undeafen, kick, or slam VC members.

name: vclimit
description: View or set the user limit for a voice channel (0 = unlimited).

name: vclock
description: Lock or blind a voice channel by toggling Connect or ViewChannel permissions for everyone.

name: vconfig
description: Configure voice command channel access (whitelist/blacklist) per role.

name: welcome
description: Manage welcome greetings and leave messages configuration.

name: withdraw
description: Withdraw money from your bank to cash

name: wv
description: Check which voice channel a user is in.
